content.text:
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>question</interview_state>
<clarification_question>Par "Error.message exact Unable to <action>: [stderr] message puis newline réel et [stdout] message", entends-tu que le message d'erreur doit être formaté exactement comme suit : "Unable to <action>: <stderr_content>\n<stdout_content>" (avec un saut de ligne réel entre stderr et stdout), ou bien "Unable to <action>: [stderr] <message>\n[stdout] <message>" (avec les crochets littéraux) ?</clarification_question>
</proposed_plan>

```xml
<proposed_plan>
<interview_state>ready</interview_state>

## Approved decisions

- **Error.message format**: Exact format "Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>" with literal brackets, real newline between sections, stderr before stdout
- **Non-empty streams only**: Only include [stderr] and [stdout] sections if their trimmed content is non-empty
- **Fallback for empty streams**: If both streams are empty/trimmed-empty, fallback to "Unable to <action>: exit code N" where N is the actual exit code
- **Success unchanged**: Success cases remain unchanged - no modification to existing success behavior
- **Private interfaces preserved**: All private interfaces in acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts must remain unchanged
- **Testing approach**: Five public API tests in acp-sandbox/test/runtime.test.ts using runCodex with fakeExecutor/sandboxScenario
- **Test scenarios**: sbx create (not create --help) with: both streams, stderr only, stdout only, none, success
- **No direct assertions**: Never use assertSuccess/requireSuccess directly or with any
- **No dependency changes**: No modifications to package.json, package-lock.json, or any dependencies
- **Execution**: Fresh sandbox with npm ci at ROOT then npm test at ROOT for monorepo
- **Update existing tests**: Modify any existing test expectations that are affected by these changes
- **Artifacts**: One vertical ticket, spec/ticket in .scratch allowed and required for full pipeline
- **No ADR/glossary**: Explicitly no ADR or glossary updates needed
- **Output format**: T01 returns JSON object contract acp.implementation-result/v1; review JSON acp.verification-report/v1
- **Pipeline**: Full complete pipeline execution
</proposed_plan>
```
